notes: v1.1.116: bug/crash fixes from the field. (1) Screen-learning in the account-create / ADB vision flow silently did nothing - a create-context logger takes only a message while screen_vision logs with a level, so every learn/save raised a TypeError that was swallowed; it now accepts either logger. (2) The UI could freeze for 8-15s inside the bug-reporter itself: a log-scrubbing regex backtracked on a long dotted string; scrubbing is now backtrack-proof and input-bounded, so reporting never stalls the window. Carries 1.1.115 (website orders - Post Comment / Reaction / Review / Follow - run on the www desktop viewer in both Mobile and Web Mode; reel comments go through the reel's own box) and 1.1.114 (Page right-click Browser parity, View IMAP to front, human-paced unlock resend).
